definition: a word or custom that marks out who belongs to a group and who does not
hook: A whole army was sorted out by the way men pronounced one word.
modernAnchor: A password, a shared joke, a way of saying a word that tells people whose side you are on. We call it a shibboleth.
journey: In the book of Judges, the men of Gilead held the fords of the Jordan against the fleeing men of Ephraim.
Everyone who wanted to cross was made to say one word. The Ephraimites could not manage the sh, and said sibboleth.
That slip was the entire test. Judges counts forty-two thousand dead at the river over a sound they could not make.
Scholars still argue whether the word meant an ear of grain or a flowing stream. The guards did not care what it meant, only how it sounded.
